prompt_definitions.simple_vision: Read the visible document. Transcribe the material billing facts actually visible: invoice identifier, document date if shown, supplier, agreement, equipment/item identifiers and serial numbers, service dates, quantities, rates, line amounts, subtotal/net/total, and currency. Do not infer missing values. For each field, say whether it is explicit or not visible. Return a concise plain-text transcription.
prompt_definitions.case_B_simple_vision: Read the visible rental return/off-hire record. Transcribe only the facts visibly stated: agreement identifier, equipment/item and unit count, serial number, returned date, any asset still on hire and its through-date, signature and site confirmation text, and any asset explicitly not returned. Do not infer missing values. Clearly distinguish returned assets from those remaining on hire. Return a concise plain-text transcription.

Use limitations only for unreadable, omitted or genuinely ambiguous source-local content. Do not list normal facts absent from this document but present in another, such as an invoice without the contractual daily rate or stop clause. Do not claim a visual transcription is human verified. Keep conflicts and uncertainty visible. Do not approve privacy, facts, links, financial claims or delivery.

decision.H1_model_cannot_read_pixels: not supported as dominant; simple Luna read A repeatedly and B correctly
decision.H2_120dpi_rendering_loss: minor contributing effect for exact end-date exclusivity; 300 DPI corrected it, but 120 DPI carried all core invoice facts in simple reads
decision.H3_prompt_or_schema_suppresses_extractio: strongly supported; production raw output omitted facts while image-identical simple prompts elicited them; no validators rejected the current raw facts
decision.H4_provenance_validator_rejects_correct_: not reproduced in new direct extraction; historical invalid outputs lacked raw logs, so those specific rejections remain unclassified
decision.H5_orchestration_loses_information: supported at adjudication: citation is restricted to facts already proposed, so adjudicator cannot recover a correct new observation after both passes omit it
decision.H6_downstream_failure: not the observed first cause; downstream stages were unreachable
decision.dominant: MIXED, dominated by production semantic prompt/task contract plus candidate-locked adjudication; 120 DPI is a secondary precision factor.

architecture_answers.1_reliability_vs_simple: The simple path recovered materially correct facts on both scans. Againward retained strong evidence gates but did not demonstrate improved end-to-end material reliability here; it suppressed extraction and then stopped.
architecture_answers.2_capability: The pipeline materially suppresses Luna visual capability at the first semantic read in these comparisons; raw production output shows omission, not validator rejection.
architecture_answers.3_demonstrable_value: Source SHA/render-unit binding and mutation detection make evidence traceable; native citation validators reject unsupported claims; independent reread exposes missing/discordant facts; deterministic arithmetic is the right authority (historical DEV calculation already demonstrates value). Final QA can guard report integrity but was not reached in this cohort.
architecture_answers.4_failure_more_than_protection: The first prompt fails to direct/permit an image-grounded fact read clearly enough; adjudication cannot add a missing proposal candidate. These failure interfaces cause more loss than the extra gates protect in the observed visual path.
architecture_answers.5_architecture_class: B — sound in principle but materially overconstrained visual path. A complete redesign is not supported by this narrow test; retaining hashes, review gates and deterministic calculation is justified.
architecture_answers.6_simpler_architecture: Plausibly superior if simplification is limited to the first semantic read: original/high-quality render → image-aware typed facts → deterministic source/page/hash binding and fact review → independent QA → deterministic calculation. Do not remove provenance checks.
architecture_answers.7_minimum_viable_next: Explicitly instruct the first and challenger readers to inspect attached original pixels and return source-local typed observations with page identity; bind source and render hashes deterministically after output. Let adjudication propose a new pixel-observed candidate into an unapproved review queue, bound to the exact disputed source/page/hash, instead of requiring that its quote already exist in a prior candidate. Keep promotion, arithmetic, and final report QA gates.

limitations: The prior ten-run raw response files were not retained, so exact values/locations for their SOURCE_LOCATION_INVALID rejections cannot be recovered; this is explicitly not guessed.
